newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar says Russians give drugs approval.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar says Russians give drugs approval.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that the Russian Ministry of Health granted marketing approval for its Ambisome antifungal and DaunoXome liposome anti-cancer drugs.

Ambisome, the company said in a statement, is currently under review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for use as a primary therapy for patients with low white blood cell counts and presumed fungal infections.

NeXstar desribed DaunoXome as a liposomal anti-cancer agent that was approved by the Russian's for treatment of Kaposi's sarcoma, including KS in AIDS patients with low lymphocyte (white blood cell) counts.
The company said Ambisome is approved for sale in 28 countries worldwide, while DaunoXome is approved in 18 countries worldwide.
